DISCUSS: BREAKING: MRI Confirms Grade 1 PCL Sprain for Gators WR Vernell Brown III
An MRI confirmed a Grade 1 PCL sprain, the mildest grade, in Vernell Brown III’s knee, sources told GatorBait. He may not miss any games.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/breaking-vernell-brown-mri-grade-1-pcl-sprain-florida-gators
By Brenden Martin. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
